findings.highlight: I wonder what it could be and roll up my sleeve.
findings.evidenceJa: 袖をめくると、そこには、
findings.governingReading: I roll up my sleeve, and there—
findings.explanation: The added hesitation is absent from Shirou’s abrupt discovery.

findings.evidenceJa: 硬い感触でもなければ
findings.explanation: A statement about tactile hardness is changed into a claim that his arm is not made of steel.

findings.highlight: girls staying in the same house
findings.evidenceJa: 一つ屋根の下で女の子が寝ている
findings.governingReading: a girl sleeping under the same roof
findings.explanation: The specific embarrassment of a girl sleeping under his roof becomes generic cohabitation and plural girls.

findings.highlight: The wounds and bruises from last night have healed.
findings.evidenceJa: 袈裟斬りにされた傷も、階段を転がり落ちた全身打撲も完治していた
findings.governingReading: Both the diagonal sword wound and the bruising over my whole body from tumbling down the stairs had completely healed.
findings.explanation: The mechanisms, extent, and complete recovery of Shirou’s injuries disappear.

findings.governingReading: the two shinai rang as they flexed and struck
findings.explanation: The English uses the malformed plural noun “clashings” and loses the two swords’ physical action.

findings.highlight: her counters are avoidable today if I become desperate
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの反撃はなんとかやり過ごせる程度
findings.governingReading: I could somehow weather Saber’s counters
findings.explanation: The English invents desperation as the condition for avoiding Saber’s counters.

findings.evidenceJa: 目の前が真っ白になる、という最悪の状態
findings.governingReading: the worst case of everything before my eyes going white
findings.explanation: A described sensory whiteout is replaced by loss of consciousness.

findings.evidenceJa: 肺にたまった熱を吐き出す
findings.governingReading: exhale the heat stored in my lungs
findings.explanation: Physical heat and exhalation disappear from the exertion image.

findings.highlight: I’m less scared of your attacks today compared to yesterday
findings.evidenceJa: 昨日に比べて厳しさを感じなかった
findings.governingReading: I didn’t feel the same severity as yesterday
findings.explanation: Saber’s attacks feeling less severe becomes Shirou being less afraid, changing the evaluated property and his characterization.
Improvement from one day to the next is stretched to an imprecise multi-day period.

findings.highlight: All teachers would lose their jobs
findings.evidenceJa: 師範代は商売あがったり
findings.governingReading: assistant instructors would be out of business
findings.explanation: A dojo-specific rank is generalized to every teacher.

findings.highlight: there are less unnecessary movements in you now
findings.evidenceJa: 型に無駄がなくなりました
findings.governingReading: the waste has disappeared from your form
findings.explanation: Saber’s technical judgment about Shirou’s form becomes an ungrammatical general statement about him.

findings.evidenceJa: 一段階上の剣士になれるのです
findings.governingReading: you can become a swordsman one level higher
findings.explanation: Saber’s concrete assessment of Shirou as a swordsman and the scale of improvement are omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 竹刀が勝手に叩き落としてくれた
findings.governingReading: my shinai seemed to knock Saber’s down by itself
findings.explanation: A forceful automatic knockdown is changed into a generic parry.

findings.highlight: if one base entered your style
findings.governingReading: once a single coherent line runs through it
findings.explanation: Saber’s metaphor for a discernible organizing principle becomes malformed English about a “base” entering a style.

findings.highlight: I can’t even see how you’re attacking
findings.evidenceJa: どうやって反撃してくるのか見えない
findings.governingReading: I can’t see how you counterattack
findings.explanation: Shirou’s specific inability to perceive Saber’s counters becomes inability to see her attacks generally.

findings.highlight: let’s not talk too much about this
findings.evidenceJa: この件について追及するのは止めよう
findings.explanation: Shirou decides to stop pursuing Saber’s grievance; the English merely limits how much they talk.

findings.highlight: It is not something that can match Archer or Berserker
findings.evidenceJa: 私やアーチャー、バーサーカーと向き合える物ではない
findings.governingReading: It is nowhere near enough to face me, Archer, or Berserker
findings.explanation: Saber removes herself from the explicit list of opponents Shirou still cannot face, distorting the scene’s power scale.

findings.evidenceJa: ぴしゃりと言い放つセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber states it sharply and decisively
findings.explanation: The force of Saber’s rebuke disappears.
